content: शस्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [शंस्-क्त] .²1 Praised, extolled. .²2 Auspicious, happy; शस्ताः कुर्वन्ति मां सव्यं दक्षिणं पशवोऽपरे <ls>Bhāg. 1. 14. 13</ls>. .²3 Right, best. .²4 Repeated, recited. .²5 Best, excellent. .²6 Wounded, injured. .²7 Killed. .{@-स्तम्@} .²1 Happiness, welfare. .²2 Excellence, auspiciousness. .²3 The body. .²4 A finger-guard (अङ्गुलित्राण <ab>q. v.</ab>; also शस्तकम् in this sense). .{@-स्तः@} A murderer.
